issue.title: test_launcher_qualifies_research_swarm_per_dispatch fails deterministically after tests/test_launch_planned_agent_name.py in the same process
issue.description:
`tests/test_multi_prompt_launcher_xprompt_groups.py::test_launcher_qualifies_research_swarm_per_dispatch`
fails deterministically whenever it runs in the same process after
`tests/test_launch_planned_agent_name.py` or `tests/test_launch_planned_bead_work.py`.
The second `#!research_swarm` dispatch keeps allocating `research.0` instead of
advancing to `research.1`, so `launch_agents_from_cwd` raises
`AgentNameLaunchCollisionError: Agent name 'research.0.cdx' is taken.`

The test writes a real agent for `research.0.cdx` between the two dispatches and clears
`sase.agent.names._registry._CACHE_PATH/_CACHE_SIGNATURE/_CACHE_DATA`, so some *other*
process-global cache consulted by the `{@1}` swarm-index allocation still holds a view
in which `research.0` is free after one of those two files has run. That state survives
into the tmp `SASE_HOME` the test installs, which is the leak to find.

Found while splitting `src/sase/main/project_handler.py` into modules: that diff changed
only which tests the diff-scoped lane co-schedules, and the failure reproduces on a
clean `master` tree (e395acd4c) with the two-file command, so it is not caused by that
change.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Not intermittent: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_launch_planned_agent_name.py tests/test_multi_prompt_launcher_xprompt_groups.py -q` fails 3/3 runs, and the same two-file command fails on a stashed, clean `master` checkout (e395acd4c). `tests/test_launch_planned_bead_work.py` is a second independent trigger (also 1/1). The node passes 4/4 in isolation and 1/1 when the whole `tests/test_multi_prompt_*.py` set runs serially, and the full `just test` lane (33,891 tests) passes — the failure depends purely on which files precede it in one worker process, not on timing. It was hit 3/3 times through `just check`'s diff-scoped lane and 1/1 by replaying that lane's 287-file selection with plain `pytest -n 4`.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired ACE TUI flake umbrella; this node is not an ACE TUI test and has a deterministic serial repro, so it is filed narrowly per that bead's retirement policy instead of corroborating it.
